Name: Rabbit Clovers
Author: UnityAndTheSystem
Description:
As many other players of Stardew Valley, I felt pretty uncomfortable at the thought of sweet little bunnies losing their feet. After looking around for some replacement mods, I stumbled upon a few mods, my favorite being the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/replace-rabbits-foot-with-four-leaf-clover-content-patcher.149003/#post-3373062]Foot for Clover mod[/url]﻿ by sheetcakeghost. Unfortunately, this mod is outdated and doesn't work for Stardew Valley 1.5.4. This was obviously a huge bummer, so I tried my hand at modding and whipped up this little mod right here!
If anyone wants to add some translations for the two lines of dialog that are changed with this mod, please message me and I will add it to the mod!

As requested, here's a link to a similar mod by DaisyNiko, if you want a Rabbit's Foot replacement that's linked a little more closely to our fuzzy little friends!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3637]Rabbit Floof mod by DaisyNiko[/url]

Manifest.Name: Rabbit Clovers
Manifest.Description: replaces the Rabbit's Foot item with a Four Leaf Clover
Manifest.Author: LorenOlson
